articles.summary: DuPont today announced the launch of Inge™ ultrafiltration modules with integrated pre-filter (iP-F).
articles.title: DuPont launches ultrafiltration modules with integrated pre-filter

articles.summary: DuPont today announced the launch of two new reverse osmosis membrane elements – FilmTec™ Fortilife™ XC-Max UHP element and FilmTec™ Fortilife™ XC220 element – designed to help industrial customers improve water recovery and optimize Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) and Minimal Liquid Discharge (MLD) system performance.
articles.title: DuPont Expands FilmTec™ Fortilife™ Portfolio for Advanced ZLD/MLD and resource recovery applications

articles.summary: DuPont today announced the launch of DuPont™ AmberChrom™ XT20 SL and XT30 SL chromatography resins, expanding its bioprocessing portfolio to help manufacturers streamline purification operations for oligonucleotide and peptide therapeutics.
articles.title: DuPont Launches DuPont™ AmberChrom™ XT SL Chromatography Resins to Simplify Biopharmaceutical Workflows

articles.summary: DuPont announced its new 2035 Sustainability Goals, outlining how the company will deliver growth through its progress in key impact areas of Sustainable Innovation, Resilient Operations, and People, Partners and Communities — all rooted in Strong Governance.
articles.title: DuPont Announces New 2035 Sustainability Goals

articles.summary: DuPont published its 2026 Sustainability Report, detailing significant progress in 2025 towards its climate and sustainability ambitions and introducing nine goals with deliverables through 2035.
articles.title: DuPont Publishes 2026 Sustainability Report
DuPont Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call

articles.summary: DuPont announced it has completed the previously-announced divestiture of its Aramids business (Kevlar® and Nomex®) to Arclin, a portfolio company of an affiliate of TJC, L.P. (TJC).
articles.title: DuPont Completes Divestiture of Aramids Business

articles.summary: DuPont announced that two of its innovative advanced solutions, FilmTec™ Fortilife™ XC160UHP and Tychem® 6000 SFR, were recognized with the prestigious 2026 Edison Awards™.
articles.title: DuPont Wins Two 2026 Edison Awards™
